# video-notes.md — Antonia's taste and filming notes

`digiroo-video` reads this before every shoot card and every cut. Claude adds a dated line when she gives a note on a cut ("Taste") or when a clip check finds the same problem twice ("Filming notes"). Write the notes in her words. If a note contradicts `video-rules.md`, the rule wins and Claude asks her once. One week's note is about that video; it becomes a standing preference only when she says "always" or it comes up again.
